{{dablink|For other uses of the word "red," see [[Red]].}}
The '''red cockleburr''' is a plant that cannot be found for one hundred miles south of the island of [[Tar Valon]].{{ref/book|8|26}}

One red cockleburr was found on the saddlecloth of [[Zerah Dacan]], leading her to confess to [[Seaine Herimon]] and [[Pevara Tazanovni]] that while she did ride down the bank of the [[Erinin]] to the village of [[Jualdhe]], she did not actually begin her journey to Tar Valon from the north as she had implied.{{ref/book|8|26}}
